title: The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
description:
S1
A boy (Scott Sealey) upset by his parents' divorce must also tell the sheriff his father (Kerwin Mathews) is a werewolf.

title: Bride of Frankenstein
description:
S1
Baron Frankenstein (Colin Clive) creates a hissing, frizzy-haired female (Elsa Lanchester) for his other monster (Boris Karloff).

title: The Brides of Dracula
description:
S1
Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt).

title: The Car
description:
S1
A Western deputy sheriff (James Brolin) chases a driverless black car that keeps running people down.

title: Creature From the Black Lagoon
description:
S1
Fossil hunters (Richard Carlson, Julia Adams, Richard Denning) encounter a dangerous, humanlike amphibian in the Amazon.

title: The Creature Walks Among Us
description:
S1
Scientists (Jeff Morrow, Rex Reason) capture the creature from the black lagoon and turn him into an air breather.

title: Curse of the Undead
description:
S1
A cow-town preacher (Eric Fleming) shoots a custom bullet at a vampire gunfighter (Michael Pate) in the Old West.

title: The Curse of the Werewolf
description:
S1
The son of a servant assaulted by a beggar becomes a wolfman in 18th-century Spain.

title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
description:
S1
A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

title: The Deadly Mantis
description:
S1
A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

title: Dr. Cyclops
description:
S1
A mad doctor (Albert Dekker) in Peru reduces a woman (Janice Logan) and three men to one-fifth their normal size.

title: Frankenstein
description:
S1
Baron Frankenstein creates a monster from cadavers and a killer's brain.
